his-b114: With MDMA, I treat jaw tension as the earliest warning that the body needs more magnesium. I don't have studies to back this up, but everyone I know who has taken enough magnesium chloride to make the jaw tension fully release has avoided the MDMA toxicity symptoms they get otherwise.
his-b118: My second wife had severe convulsions after an MDMA overdose. At the hospital, they figured out what caused that: her potassium was found to be critically low, and IV potassium was the only treatment they gave her. That experience is what leads me to treat serious MDMA toxicity as a broader electrolyte emergency, although magnesium is still the first and most useful supplement to give once the jaw tenses, since potassium gets depleted after magnesium.
